Question Choices: Calculate: 3 * 5 1/6 (provide your answer as a mixed number. When you write your mixed number, write the whole number first, then leave a space and write the fraction part using the / sign)
Hints: Multiply both the whole and fractional parts by the whole-number factor, then regroup and simplify.
Solution: Distribute 3 to both parts: 3 x 5 = 15; 3 x 1/6 = 3/6. Combine 15 + 3/6 = 15 1/2. As an improper fraction, 5 1/6 = 31/6, so the product is 93/6.
